facts.activity_file: making up, decanting and dosing reagents

consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: restraint and placarding of transported loads
controlled make-up, decanting and dosing of reagents

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.title: stored energy found after isolation of P-8304

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control EXPOSURE_MONITORING: the monitoring of airborne contaminant exposure had degraded below its design intent, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control LOAD_RESTRAINT_AND_PLACARDING: the restraint and placarding of transported loads was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control REAGENT_HANDLING_CONTROL: the controlled make-up, decanting and dosing of reagents was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Restore the restraint and placarding of transported loads on P-8304 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in handling and dosing reagents, specifically making up, decanting and dosing reagents. P-8304 (reagent dosing pumps) is in service for reagent make-up and dosing. The task proceeded during an intrusive maintenance task while the monitoring of airborne contaminant exposure had degraded below its design intent. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 30 May 2013 a hazard report was recorded on P-8304 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station during an intrusive maintenance task; chemical energy held as hydrocarbon was not released.
